subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the first day event in the decathlon?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Discus throw.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• The first day of the decathlon typically includes five events: **100-meter dash, long jump, shot put, high jump, and 400-meter dash.**
 
• The **Discus throw **is usually the** second event** on the second day of the decathlon.
 
• The **Shot put** is the first event of the** decathlon**, which tests the **athlete's strength and technique** in throwing a heavy ball as far as possible.
 
• The **100-meter dash** is also one of the events on the first day, which tests the **athlete's speed and acceleration.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Decathlon** is a** track and field event** consisting of ten track and field events, which are completed over **two days.**
 
• The** ten events **are: the 100-metre dash, long jump, shot put, high jump, 400-metre dash, 110-metre hurdles, discus throw, pole vault, javelin throw, and 1500-metre run.
 
• The Shot put is the first event of the decathlon, which is followed by the** Long jump, High jump, 400-metre dash, and 110-metre hurdles.**
 
• The **100-metre dash** is the first event of the Heptathlon, which is a **women's track and field **event consisting of seven events.
